## Summary

I resolved ticket T-6002 by identifying that the docindex StatefulSet scale-up failed because the CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable was not updated when the replica count was increased. Pod docindex-3 logs confirmed it was in standby mode due to being outside the configured cluster size of 3, causing its readiness probe to fail with HTTP 503. This also prevented docindex-4 from being created since StatefulSets require sequential pod readiness. The fix is to patch the StatefulSet to update the CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable from 3 to 5, which will trigger a rolling update and allow all five replicas to join the cluster properly.
